name: short
description: 30 turns about one topic: planning an allotment garden.

turns.content: The garden plot is number 17 at the Linden Lane allotments.
Noted: plot 17 at Linden Lane.
The courgettes look a bit pale. Is that a problem?
Pale courgettes often want more light or a little compost. Check the soil first.
The raised bed I built is 240 cm long and 90 cm wide.
A 240 by 90 cm bed gives you room for three short rows.
How deep should the mulch be around the beans?
About five centimetres around the beans, kept a hand's width from the stems.
My neighbour on the plot, Agnes Varro, lends me her wheelbarrow.
Good to have Agnes Varro next door.
Can the tomatoes grow next to the radishes?
Yes, the tomatoes and the radishes get along; give each its own row so they share the light.
I sowed the first beans on 14 April.
Beans sown on 14 April should flower by early June.
Can the onions grow next to the carrots?
Yes, the onions and the carrots get along; give each its own row so they share the light.
The tomato variety I chose is called Copper Lantern.
Copper Lantern it is; it likes a sheltered spot.
Should I water the tomatoes in the morning or the evening?
Morning is better for the tomatoes: the leaves dry before night, which keeps mould away.
The water tap is at the north gate, about 35 metres from my bed.
35 metres is a long walk with cans; a hose may pay off.
Can the tomatoes grow next to the courgettes?
Yes, the tomatoes and the courgettes get along; give each its own row so they share the light.
We decided to skip potatoes this year because of the blight last season.
Skipping potatoes for a year is wise after blight.
Should I water the radishes in the morning or the evening?
Morning is better for the radishes: the leaves dry before night, which keeps mould away.
The plot rent is 46 euros per year, due every March.
So 46 euros each March.
How deep should the mulch be around the radishes?
About five centimetres around the radishes, kept a hand's width from the stems.
I put the compost bin in the south-east corner.
The south-east corner gets some sun, which helps the compost warm up.
What do I do with the weeds between the beans?
Pull them by hand after rain, when the roots come out whole.
The shed padlock code is 4-1-9-6.
I'll remember the shed code 4-1-9-6.
Should I water the beans in the morning or the evening?
Morning is better for the beans: the leaves dry before night, which keeps mould away.
My soil test came back with a pH of 6.4.
A pH of 6.4 is close to ideal for most vegetables.
Is it too late to sow more courgettes?
Not yet. A second sowing of courgettes still has time before the nights turn cold.
The allotment open day is on Saturday 21 June.
21 June it is; the beds should look good by then.
Can the radishes grow next to the carrots?
Yes, the radishes and the carrots get along; give each its own row so they share the light.
I ordered netting from the club shop for 12 euros 50.
12.50 for netting is fair; it keeps the birds off the lettuce.
Can the radishes grow next to the beans?
Yes, the radishes and the beans get along; give each its own row so they share the light.
The carrots went into row three, next to the onions.
Carrots next to onions confuses the carrot fly; good choice.
What do I do with the weeds between the carrots?
Pull them by hand after rain, when the roots come out whole.
I plan to harvest the courgettes every two days once they start.
Every two days keeps the courgettes small and tender.
Can the courgettes grow next to the carrots?
Yes, the courgettes and the carrots get along; give each its own row so they share the light.
